entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: Planeswalker who, posing as Boros Commander Jura, leads the plan to retake the Ninth District of Ravnica.

entities.name: Anza
entities.description: Boros scout who runs messages for Gideon.

entities.name: Dars Gostok
entities.description: Captain of the Boros legion known as the Firefist.

entities.name: Jazek
entities.description: Corporal of the Firefist serving under Dars.

entities.name: Tajic
entities.description: Smiling Boros maze runner and knight who lures the Rakdos into the square.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: Angelic Boros warmaster who thanks Gideon and invites him to join the Boros.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: Orzhov leader who cashed in favors to gain intelligence against Dimir sleeper cells and oversees the Ninth's welfare.

entities.name: Krokt
entities.description: Giant Gruul warrior swinging a massive club.

entities.name: Ninth District
entities.description: Ravnican district that many guilds have failed to reclaim.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Guild-ruled plane where the battle takes place.

entities.name: Sunhome
entities.description: Boros guildhall where Gideon is told he is always welcome.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: Ravnican guild of soldiers led by Aurelia, fighting in the Ninth.

entities.name: Firefist
entities.description: Boros legion commanded by Dars Gostok.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: Raging Ravnican guild of warriors and beasts in the Ninth, including clans Ghor and Scab-Clan.

entities.name: Rakdos Cult
entities.description: Guild of demons and deviants lured into the battle by Tajic.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: Guild whose enforcers and knights helped root out Dimir agents in the Ninth.

entities.name: Dimir
entities.description: Guild of puppetmasters whose sleeper cells were embedded in the Ninth.

entities.name: Obzedat
entities.description: Ghostly council of the Orzhov, which struck a deal sharing protection of the Ninth with the Boros.

events.summary: Gideon and Anza bait the Gruul giant Krokt into wrecking buildings while Gideon sends Anza to tell Dars to get into position.
events.quote: Get back to the square, tell Dars that we're coming and to get into position.

events.summary: Dars assembles the Firefist, hidden in buildings around the square.
events.quote: Gideon had Dars assemble the Boros legion known as the Firefist in the square, hidden in the surrounding buildings.

events.summary: Gideon leads a horde of Gruul into the square, where the Boros fire down on them from rooftops.
events.quote: From the rooftops and upper floors, a blaze of Boros magic lit the square with streams of fire that slammed into the Gruul.

events.summary: The Boros charge the Gruul hand to hand.
events.quote: Gideon and the Boros rushed from their positions to engage the Gruul hand-to-hand.

events.summary: Tajic arrives pursued by the Rakdos, surviving a demonic spell.
events.quote: A thunderclap of demonic magic hit Tajic like a cannonball and enveloped him in a cloud of fire and sulfur.

events.summary: The Firefist opens its line and the Rakdos pour into the square, where Rakdos and Gruul slaughter each other while the Boros contain them.
events.quote: Rakdos and Gruul slaughtered each other in the center of the square

events.summary: Tajic scouts with a platoon, linking with Orzhov patrols that, through Teysa Karlov, helped root out Dimir sleeper cells; the Obzedat agree to shared protection of the Ninth.
events.quote: the Boros and Orzhov would share protection duties over the Ninth

events.summary: Aurelia thanks Gideon and asks him to join the Boros; he declines because he is needed elsewhere.
events.quote: I am needed elsewhere. There are other battles I must fight.

events.summary: Aurelia tells Gideon he is always welcome at Sunhome.
events.quote: You are always welcome at Sunhome, Jura.

relations.quote: Gideon looked for the Firefist captain.
the Boros legion known as the Firefist
You have done the Boros and me a great service, Jura,

relations.note: Gideon calls Tajic's return as promised and fights alongside him
relations.quote: I was wondering when you'd get here

relations.note: Orzhov and Boros share protection of the Ninth
relations.quote: the Boros and Orzhov would share protection duties over the Ninth

relations.note: Dimir sleeper cells are being purged
relations.quote: uprooting the Dimir sleeper cells and purging them from the Ninth was necessary
